text: You craft the perfect email, a crucial message for an important recipient. You hit send, expecting it to land right in their inbox.
But it vanishes. No reply. Later, you find out it never even reached them. It went... to the dreaded spam folder.
Why? You might blame keywords – 'money', 'free', 'urgent'. You picture a simple filter, scanning for those obvious red flags.
But the system is far more complex. It's not just about your words, it's about you – your sender's reputation.
It tracks how many recipients open your emails, mark them as 'not spam', or even reply. It remembers your past behavior and your server's history.
So, to get into the inbox, you need to earn trust. Every interaction, every open, every 'not spam' click, builds your invisible score.
